saturn.name: Obsidian Void
saturn.description: A vast expanse of black volcanic glass, where jagged obsidian spires pierce through eternal twilight.

venus.name: Crystalline Garden
venus.description: A lush sanctuary of prismatic crystals and bioluminescent flora. Soft pink and emerald light filters through translucent formations.

jupiter.name: Golden Temple Realm
jupiter.description: Majestic floating temples of gold and bronze suspended among massive gas clouds. Thunder rolls eternally in the distance.

mars.name: Crimson Battlefield
mars.description: A landscape of red iron oxide dunes and ancient weapon-forges frozen in time. The ground pulses with buried aggression.

sun.name: Solar Throne
sun.description: A brilliant realm of pure light where golden palaces float in the corona of an eternal star.

moon.name: Silver Dreamscape
moon.description: An ethereal realm of silver mists and reflective pools. Reality bends softly at the edges.

mercury.name: Mercury Spire
mercury.description: A lightning-fast realm of quicksilver rivers and crystalline information towers. Thought becomes form instantly.

rahu.name: Shadow Maze
rahu.description: An unsettling labyrinth of smoky shadows and distorted reflections. Nothing is as it seems.

ketu.name: Emptiness Monastery
ketu.description: A serene void of minimal forms and spiritual silence. Detachment brings clarity.

seeker.description: journey of discovery, hidden paths, ancient wisdom

warrior.description: test of strength, battle remnants, honorable combat

sage.description: contemplation spaces, knowledge artifacts, serene study

mystic.description: sacred geometry, ritual spaces, esoteric symbols

wanderer.description: endless horizons, resting places, nomadic elements

builder.description: construction sites, materials and tools, foundation stones

healer.description: restoration pools, medicinal flora, sanctuary spaces

trickster.description: hidden passages, illusion elements, playful surprises
